jurisdictions.coverage_note: No permit page exists on the village site. The site carries Ordinances, Zoning Ordinances, Public Works and Contact only.

Whether Carbon Cliff permit records live inside the East Moline iWorQ instance could not be confirmed, because that instance returns nothing without an exact permit number. Recorded as unconfirmed rather than guessed.

corrections.was: It is PDF, so it needs extraction, and it is report-level rather than record-level.
corrections.now: The monthly reports are record-level. Each prints one row per permit with permit number, date, parties, description, parcel key, address and valuation. Verified against 15 reports spanning 2017-01 to 2026-04.

corrections.was: parcel-keyed permit lookup does not appear to be offered publicly anywhere in the county
corrections.now: True of the live portals, not of the published reports. The legacy reports print a TAX_MAP legacy parcel key that matched the parcel layer's RICO_PARCE for 98.50% of a 1,200-record sample, and the 2026-04 EnerGov report prints the 10-digit county PIN directly.

corrections.was: monthly PDF reports measured p50 1365 ms
corrections.now: 1365 ms is the index page. Document fetches measured p50 2724 ms and p95 5977 ms over 15 sequential downloads, so a polite full harvest of 111 reports takes about 9.3 minutes, not the ~190 s the feasibility table estimated.
